crash.title: CamStack Agent UI crashed
crash.body: The dashboard hit an unexpected error while rendering. The agent itself keeps running — this only affects the UI. Details below (also in the agent log).
crash.startFailed: CamStack Agent UI failed to start

locked.title: Agent dashboard locked
locked.body: This agent is paired with a hub. Sign in on the hub as an admin to unlock this dashboard.
locked.hubUnknown: Hub address unknown — open this agent from System → Cluster → Open dashboard.

hubConfig.title: Hub Connection

certRejected.title: The hub refused this agent's certificate
certRejected.message: The certificate was revoked or was issued by another hub. Forget the hub below, then pair this agent again from the hub.

unreachable.title: Hub unreachable
unreachable.message: This agent is paired but cannot reach the hub right now. Check that the hub is running and reachable from this machine.

hubConfig.unsupported: This agent is too old to pair from here. Update it from the hub (Cluster → Nodes), then pair it again.
hubConfig.emptyPairing: This agent is not paired. On the hub open Cluster → Nodes, find this agent under "Agents found on the network" and start pairing; the request appears here.

name.label: Agent Name
name.remoteHint: Renaming is done on the machine itself.

paired.forgetDescription: This agent erases the certificate the hub issued and disconnects. Its cameras stop being served from this node until a hub pairs with it again, which needs a new confirmation on both screens.

requests.pinHelp: The one-time PIN is shown only on the agent's own machine: in the agent console (docker logs for a container), in pairing-pin.txt in the agent data directory, or in the desktop app window. Use the PIN printed for this hub.
requests.codeHelp: The {{digits}}-digit code the hub shows for this pairing. Type it from the hub screen.
requests.pickOne_one: {{count}} hub asked to pair - pick the one you mean
requests.pickOne_other: {{count}} hubs asked to pair - pick the one you mean
requests.lockedMessage: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{wait}}, or reset the pairing lockout below.
requests.confirmedHint: Now type this code on the hub. This agent pairs as soon as the hub accepts it.
requests.noPinNeeded: You are on the agent itself, so no PIN is needed.
requests.agentCodeLabel: Code on this agent - type it on the hub
requests.noCodeReturned: The agent confirmed but did not return its code. Reject this request and start the pairing again from the hub.

reset.codeHelp: The reset code is printed in the agent console at boot (docker logs for a container) and kept in pairing-reset.txt in the agent data directory. It is renewed each time it is used.
reset.done: Pairing reset: lockouts and pending requests are cleared.
reset.explain: Use this when confirming is locked after wrong PINs, or a stuck request keeps the agent from accepting a new one. It cancels every pending pairing; the hub can then ask again.
reset.noCodeNeeded: This page runs on the agent itself, so no reset code is needed.

addons.title: Addons
addons.hubVersionsFailed: The hub did not answer, so the versions this node should run are unknown.
addons.startFailed: The update could not be started

columns.versionNotSortable: A version cell can also say what is being updated.

addons.publishedHint: A newer release is published. It reaches this node once the hub runs it — update the hub first.
addons.hubVersionsUnpaired: Addon versions follow the hub once this agent is paired.

updates.title: Framework update
updates.restartWarning: Applying downloads the release, then restarts this node to swap it in. Live streams and detection on this node stop for the restart, and this page goes unreachable until the agent comes back.
updates.confirmApply: Confirm — update and restart this node
updates.npmNote: The framework installs from the npm registry — this works with the hub unreachable.
